- Added new configurable match options:
-- Vacation Cash Behavior: PayoutOnly, LoseExtraRoll, SkipNextTurn. Default SkipNextTurn
-- Get Out of Jail Fine: Default 50
-- Jail Roll Attempts: Default 3
-- DoublesPenalty: GoToJail, EndTurn, None. Default GoToJail
-- Auction Initial Duration: Default 15 seconds
-- Auction Anti-Snipe Duration Extension: Default 7 seconds
-- Auction Starting Bid: Default 0
-- Property Management Timing: CurrentTurnOnly, AnyTurn, BetweenTurnsOnly. Default CurrentTurnOnly
-- Minimum Gambling Wager: Default 1
-- Maximum Wager Type: PlayerMoney, PercentagePlayerMoney, SetAmount. Default PlayerMoney
-- Maximum Wager Bank Percentage: Default 80%
-- Maximum Wager Set Amount: Default 420
-- Gambling Payout Multiplier: Default 2
-- Sent Trade Limit: Default 3
-- Allow Improved Property Trades: Default false
-- Allow Mortgaged Property Trades: Default true
